hook: bypassPermissions with no isolation is a shortcut you only take once.
body:
The video starts with the shortcut, then puts each control in its place: a sandboxed worker per task with scoped cwd and credentials, a PreToolUse hook that sees sensitive calls first, and can_use_tool parking them in an approval queue.

Once approved, the call goes through a shared MCP server fronting the system, with auditing after the fact.

The takeaway: isolation, hooks, human approval and a governed gateway each do one job. This is the enterprise-scenarios domain of the CCAR-F exam.

🔊 Turn the sound on for the walkthrough.
